root_cause: Manager and members treated detailed-design refinements (-5% to complement +5%, formal fatigue sentence, catalog selection) as pre-proposal blocking objections and encoded them as O2/O3 in open_questions/open_question, so closure was capped with open blocks despite Den Hartog tuning, comfort margin, load-path continuity, and support/clearance/buildability all verified.
agenda: Targeted process problem, not broad physics failure. Concept is physically sound and buildable (Den Hartog tuning, load path, support/clearance all verified). Council as engineers should retain all sizing/architecture and change only meeting behaviour: stop treating -5% detune complement, formal Eurocode fatigue sentence, and catalog selection as pre-proposal blocks; keep +5% detune verification as sufficient for concept acceptance and list remainders as advisory detailed-design follow-ons to allow consensus close.
repeat_explanation: Not the same problem as prior S1 label-driven render failures and text-free fallback loops; this is a new targeted Stage-A concept-acceptance failure where physics/buildability already pass but process-block wording prevents consensus close.
